picks.note: Chlorophyll doubles Speed in sun. Mega Venusaur gets Thick Fat whichever you pick.
A bulky support with screens and Leech Seed. Leaf Guard rarely matters, so reset for nature only.
Unburden doubles Speed once its held item is used. Mega Sceptile gets Lightning Rod.
Slow and physical. Shell Armor blocks critical hits, a small edge over Overgrow.
Contrary turns Leaf Storm into a Special Attack boost. The clearest reset target among the Grass starters.
Physical tank. Bulletproof blocks ball and bomb moves such as Shadow Ball and Sludge Bomb.
Physical attacker. Long Reach avoids contact punishers like Rocky Helmet and Rough Skin.
Both Mega Stones override its ability. Solar Power only helps in sun and costs HP. Planning on Mega Charizard X (stone from Episode 14)? Take Jolly or Adamant instead.
Special attacker. Flash Fire makes it immune to Fire and powers up its own Fire moves.
Speed Boost raises Speed every turn. The most popular pick in Reborn. Lonely, Naughty, Hasty, Naive and neutral natures are also fine.
Iron Fist powers up Mach Punch, Drain Punch and the elemental punches.
Thick Fat Tepig becomes Reckless Emboar, which boosts Flare Blitz and Wild Charge. It is slow, so Speed is the stat to drop.
Fast special attacker. Magician steals items and Blaze boosts Fire moves, so either ability works.
Intimidate cuts the foe's Attack on entry. One of the strongest picks for the whole game.
Mega Blastoise gets Mega Launcher regardless. Rain Dish only helps in rain, so Torrent is fine too.
Sheer Force strips side effects for 30% more power on moves like Ice Fang, Crunch and Waterfall.
Damp almost never matters, so take Torrent. Water/Ground has a single weakness (Grass). Mega Swampert gets Swift Swim.
Empoleon attacks specially, so Defiant's Attack boost is wasted. Take Torrent.
Mixed attacker. Shell Armor only blocks critical hits, so Torrent is the better pick. Choose the nature for the side you plan to use.
Protean gives every move the same-type bonus. Fast and frail.
Liquid Voice turns Hyper Voice into a Water move that hits both foes in doubles.
